Mockup 37, v6. vos-ship-concepts. Three fighters of the Syndicate's own (21 to 23, at the back of the board), and six specialists of about cruiser size, each a freighter's drive block with one trade built on it: boarding, mines, tractor beams, rock breaking, fighters, and passing as a freighter.

Notes

Version 6 (you: "pirate fighters need to be unique, like more fighter looking!"). Three fighters of the Syndicate's own, 21 Cutter, 22 Twin boom and 23 Stack, each about 16 m: wings, guns out at the tips or under the nose, one or two big engines and a blunt glazed nose. A fighter is small enough for a clan's yard to weld whole round a salvaged engine, so these are the one thing the Vos build. The Saucer runner now carries six Cutters in place of the stolen Institute fighters. They are tiny on the board; pick one in the list to see it close.

Version 5 (you: "the ships I wanted were not 5,6 it was saucer runner and boarder"; "they are all roughly cruiser sized ships with hull on the lower side, but all are specialized"; "and of course, disguising themselves as freighters too"). The Boarder and the Saucer runner are back; the Twin haul, the Prize frigate, the Castle and the Delta are off the board.

The Vos have no ladder of bigger and bigger classes. Every ship is about cruiser size, 150 to 180 m, built on a freighter's drive block and a short length of its spine, with a weaker hull than a warship of its size. Each has one trade: the Boarder boards, the Drum lays mines, the Cross holds with tractor beams, the Ram breaks rocks, the Saucer runner launches fighters, and the Broadside is the one that passes closest as a freighter.

All six are made of freighter parts, so all of them read as freighters from far off. That is the disguise.

Version 4 (you: "I also dont like pointy noses, please fix that"). Every bow the Syndicate welds now ends in a flat face: a blunt armoured bulkhead, a glazed face, or the Ram's hammer head.

Version 3 (you: "6 and 5 are cool, but I would like you to create some unique battle freighter designs"). Six battle freighters whose layouts are the Syndicate's own replace version 2's other conversions.

Each is still made the way a clan makes a ship: a real freighter's drive block and spine, cut to length, with the game's containers bolted on. What is new is the arrangement, and each arrangement is for fighting: a gun line, a drum of missile pods, a cross of gun arms, an armoured ram, a stern tower, two swept wings.

A container on these ships is never just cargo. It is a gun house, a missile pod, a magazine or quarters for a boarding crew, which is why a battle freighter still looks like a freighter.

Taken parts are the game's own ships at true size, in a dulled version of their makers' colours. The Syndicate's own metal (armour, arms, hubs, prows, guns) is rust plate with a brass rail; a gun's mouth is lit verdigris.
